item.tib: ge khod dbang rgyal lha yi pho nya ri rong nag mo stag ri rong sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs klog zhags 'phreng ba
item.coloph: man ngag 'di ni ye shes dbal mo stag ri rong gi sgrub thabs bstan pa srog gi ka ba/ g.yung drung bon gyi srung ma/ zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen gyis brnag pa rdzogs so//
